research_question: Can a controlled qubit protocol decompose incompatibility-limited preparation uncertainty, apparatus error/disturbance, decoherence, and classical readout noise, and identify which contribution limits an information task?
hard_invariants: Preparation uncertainty and measurement error-disturbance are not treated as the same theorem.
Decoherence and readout noise are modeled separately from intrinsic incompatibility.
Quantum error correction is not described as removing noncommutation.
No observed hardware result is invented.
recommended_direction_space: Entropic uncertainty with calibrated quantum memory
